greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka qof taagan meel sare oo uu ka eegayo dhismaha weyn ee uu rabo inuu dhiso. Wuxuu gacanta ku hayaa qorshihii, wuxuu hayaa qalabkii, laakiin wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu fadhiisto oo uu xisaabiyo kharashka. Ma ku filan tahay waxa aan haysto? Ma dhammaystiri karaa waxa aan bilaabay? Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in xerta dhabta ah ay tahay qofka garanaya inuu qaato iskutallaabtiisa. Waa qofka aan degdegin, ee fadhiista, oo dareemaya miisaanka nolosha, ka dibna go'aansada inuu raaco Masiixa xataa marka jidku uu culus yahay.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay sida qorshe weyn oo u baahan in si taxaddar leh loo dhiso. Waxaan ognahay inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin xusuusiyo hal shay oo ka mid ah nolosha Ben oo muujinaysa inuu fahmay 'kharashka' nolosha ee uu Ciise ka hadlayo. Xusuuso markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Wuxuu ahaa wiil diyaar u ahaa inuu 'kharashka' jacaylka bixiyo, xataa marka uusan haysan wax badan.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Ilaah waa kan inagu shaqeeya, si aan u helno rabitaanka iyo awoodda aan ku samayno waxa uu isagu rabo.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil Ilaah ku dhex shaqeeyay. Wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay indho xiiso leh, isagoo mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu wax barto. Wuxuu ahaa wiil nolosha u arkaayay safar, sida safaradii uu qoyskiisa la galay ee uu dunida ku soo arkay. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo ka dhergay jacaylka Ilaah. Waxaan xusuustaa riyadii aad la wadaagteen, markii Ben uu ku yiri: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si kaamil ah. Wuxuu hadda joogaa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo nabad qaba.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida kursiga uu qof kasta u tartamayo, Ben wuxuu doorbiday inuu noqdo mid fudud, mid jecel, oo mid naftiisa u hura dadka kale. Jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii dhex joogay, waxaana naftayda kuu huraa gebi ahaanba. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligeed ah, aan Rabbiga u baryootanno.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska qaada, inuu Ilaah qalbigooda u dejiyo, uuna siiyo rajo iyo xoog, aan Rabbiga u baryootanno.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Gacaliye-yaalow, sidaad mar walba u addeeci jirteen, ha ahaato markaan joogo oo keliya, laakiin ha ahaato in ka sii badan hadda markaan maqanahay, badbaadadiinna ku shaqeeya cabsi iyo gariir. Waayo Ilaah waa kan, ujeeddadiisa wanaagsan aawadeed, idinku dhex shaqeeya si aad u heshaan rabitaanka iyo awoodda aad wax u qabataan. Wax walba ku sameeya cabasho iyo dood la'aan, si aad u noqotaan kuwo aan eed lahayn oo saafi ah, carruurta Ilaah oo aan iin lahayn dhexda qarni qalloocan oo xun, kuwaas oo aad dhex joogtaan sida nalalka dunida, idinkoo haysta ereyga nolosha, si aan ugu faano maalinta Masiixa inaanan orod iyo hawlba waxtar la'aan u gelin. Laakiin, xataa haddii la igu shubo sida qurbaan loo bixiyay oo kale adeegga allabariga ee iimaankiinna, waan farxayaa, farxaddaydana waan idinla qaybsanayaa. Sidaas oo kale, idinkuna waa inaad faraxdaan oo aad farxaddiinna ila qaybsataan.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu waa nuurkayga iyo badbaadadayda; yaan ka cabsadaa? Rabbigu waa magangalka naftayda; yaan ka baqaa? Hal shay ayaan Rabbiga ka baryayaa; tan ayaan doonayaa: Inaan guriga Rabbiga dego cimrigayga oo dhan, si aan u fiiriyo quruxda Rabbiga oo aan u fiirsado macbudkiisa. Waxaan aaminsanahay inaan arki doono nimcada Rabbiga ee dalka kuwa nool. Rabbiga u sug geesinnimo; is-adkee, oo Rabbiga sug.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Dad badan ayaa la socday Ciise, wuuna u soo jeestay oo wuxuu ku yiri, 'Haddii qof ii yimaado isagoon neceb aabbihiis iyo hooyadiis, naagtiisa iyo carruurtiisa, walaalihiis iyo walaalihiis, iyo xataa naftiisa, ma noqon karo xertayda. Qofkii aan qaadan iskutallaabtiisa oo aan ii soo raacin ma noqon karo xertayda. Kumaa idinka mid ah oo doonaya inuu dhiso munaarad aan marka hore fadhiisan oo xisaabin kharashka si uu u arko haddii ay ku filan tahay dhammaystirkeeda? Haddii kale, ka dib markuu aasaaska dhigo oo uu kari waayo inuu shaqada dhammaystiro, dadka daawanaya way ku qosli doonaan oo waxay dhihi doonaan, 'Ninkani wuxuu bilaabay inuu dhiso laakiin ma haysan khayraad uu ku dhammaystiro.' Mise boqor ku socda dagaal yaanu marka hore fadhiisan oo go'aansan haddii uu toban kun oo askari ku guulaysan karo inuu ka hortago boqor kale oo ku soo socda labaatan kun oo askari? Haddii kale, inta uu weli fog yahay, wuxuu u diri doonaa ergo si ay u weydiistaan shuruudaha nabadda. Sidaas oo kale, qof kasta oo idinka mid ah oo aan ka tanaasulin hantidiisa oo dhan ma noqon karo xertayda.'

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
